claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017.
The study discovered relationships between LDA topics and paper features, indicating researchers' interests in the field.
The evaluation involved extracting abstracts and titles from the publications to analyze trends and generate trust tags.
